transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I'm here because... well, for the last couple years, I just feel kind of low all the time. Like, even when I'm at work or church, or around people I care about... there's just this heavy, empty feeling. It doesn't really lift.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?
Um... I don't really know. I guess... I mostly just go to work and come home. I don't really do much else anymore, so... I'm not sure.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to like?
Um... probably? I just... I don't really think about it much. Like I said, I mostly just go to work and... yeah. I don't really know.
Do you feel worse in the morning?
Um... I don't think so. It's just... kind of the same all day, I guess. I haven't really noticed.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?
Um... not really. I don't think I worry about much. Just... doing what I have to do, I guess. So... no, I don't think so.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I mean... I'm usually pretty tired after being on my feet on the floor all day, but... I don't know, when I actually get in bed, I just... I can't stop thinking about all the stuff I haven't gotten done. And even if I do fall asleep, I... I just wake up feeling like I didn't really sleep at all. So... yeah.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight recently?

Um... I guess so. It fluctuates, I think. Like, most days I don't really eat until my shift is almost over... nothing really sounds good anyway. Or... I just end up getting stuff from the vending machine because I'm so tired. So... my work pants just fit different depending on the month.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to or having trouble getting things done because you're feeling sluggish?

Um... yeah, I guess. I just... I don't really have the energy for much. Even just... small stuff at work, like filling out the inspection logs. Or... trying to drive to basketball, or even just washing my hair. It just... it takes more energy than I have. And even when I try to rest on my days off, it doesn't... it doesn't really help. I just stay tired.
Do you often feel guilty or worthless?

Um... I don't know. I mean... I guess I just feel like I'm not doing a very good job at things. Like... at work, or just in general. But I don't know if I'd call it... worthless. Just... not really good enough, I guess.
Do you ever think about death or dying?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I don't really think about that kind of stuff.
Have you experienced any periods in the last two years where your low mood was significantly worse than it is now?
Um... I don't think so. It's just... pretty much been the same. Just... always kind of like this, I guess.
Do you feel like you're resting or fidgeting more than you used to?
Um... I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anything like that. Just... normal, I guess.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to?
No... not really. I mean, I just... I do things at my normal pace, I think. I haven't really paid attention to it.
Have you ever thought about harming yourself?
No... I haven't. I don't really... think about doing anything like that.
Do you feel like you're fidgeting more than you used to?
Um... no. Like I said earlier... I don't think so. I don't really fidget. It's just... the same as usual, I guess.
Do you feel like your movements or reactions are slower than they used to be?
Um... I think you just asked me about that. But, no... I don't think my reactions are any slower. Everything just feels... normal, I guess.
Do you find yourself pacing back and forth or feeling like you need to be in constant motion?
No... not really. I don't... pace. I mostly just sit still. It's... kind of like I said before, I don't feel like I need to move around.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that weren't really there?
No. Um... I've never... no. I don't have anything like that happen.
Have you had any periods in the last two years where you felt like you couldn't take care of yourself or your daily responsibilities?

Um... yeah, I guess. Work has been... hard. I've gotten some written warnings lately because I keep missing shifts, and... I haven't been turning in my inspection paperwork on time. And I just... I don't really go to things anymore. I stopped showing up for basketball and dance nights... and the church STEM mentoring thing I used to do. I just... can't.
Have you had any periods in the last two years where you felt completely unable to take care of yourself or your daily responsibilities?
I mean... I just told you about work and everything. I don't really know about completely unable. I still... I don't know. Just what I just said, I guess.
